gse244832.allowed_use: External-development RNA-query profiling and cell-state robustness after a model is fit elsewhere. The RNA and ATAC aliquots may be compared only after donor-by-cell-state aggregation.
gse244832.model_access: Different aliquots are never row-paired. Query ATAC cannot enter fitting, preprocessing, feature selection, calibration, augmentation, or inference.

gse289173.allowed_use: One-time RNA-only cell-state mapping after selection lock. No RNA-conditioned ATAC champion claim is possible because this source has no observed ATAC endpoint.
gse289173.model_access: Anonymized RNA only through the frozen RNA-query adapter; no fitting, feature selection, normalization statistics, calibration, or batch-state update.

gse296875.allowed_use: Outer-training same-nucleus RNA-ATAC pairs and donor-held development evaluation after activation and exact-row-join gates pass.
gse296875.model_access: HVGs, peaks, IDF, scale, augmentation, model state, early stopping, and calibration are fit only on outer-training donors. Held-donor ATAC is evaluator-only.

local_model_roster.common_lane: scButterfly-B frozen RNA path plus identical benchmark head
local_model_roster.native_lane: B adaptation and separately named C/T/TC augmentation variants using outer-training data only

pairing_rules.gse244832: same_sample_different_aliquot; donor-level evaluation only, never paired cells
pairing_rules.gse296875: same_nucleus; exact shared-nucleus row joins permitted only after validation

rules.biological_unit: Donors are inferential units; cells and predicted peaks are not replicates.
rules.profile_scale: Score frozen decoder values directly as continuous peak scores unless training-only calibration is prespecified; never use query-dependent inverse TF-IDF.
rules.query_isolation: Prediction code receives RNA query tensors and frozen transforms only. Observed query ATAC remains in the evaluator.
rules.transform_contract: Training-only gene/peak inventories, ATAC IDF/global scale, chromosome order, state dict, head, and calibration.
